name: Footnote
description: a footnote reference and content element
status: stable — exercised in composed page flows under e2e and axe, beyond the per-component checks
aria: `role="note"` -- indicates supplementary content that is related to the main content
`aria-label="{id}"` -- provides an accessible name derived from the footnote identifier
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `id`: string (required) -- unique footnote identifier, used for the element id and aria-label
`children`: slot (required) -- footnote content to render inside the aside
